integrity: The proof reconstructs the exact published H-description, uses connectedness of a nest to convert its facet height to a cardinality formula, normalizes every facet in the intrinsic affine metric, and proves optimality plus uniqueness from the retained singleton facets. Finite tree enumeration is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the standard-weight Loday operahedron realization and the inherited Euclidean metric. It does not cover arbitrary positive weights, affine images, circumradii, John ellipsoids, or pairwise vertex metrics. A residual originality risk remains for an equivalent generalized-permutahedron folklore observation.
title: Tree-independent Euclidean facet shells of standard Loday operahedra
